title: Issued Equipment and Uniforms: Return Period and Replacement Charges in Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
Whether district equipment or uniforms are issued for an activity type of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees**, the days allowed to return an issued item after the participation closes, and the charge per item left unreturned are the following.

| Activity type | District equipment or uniforms issued | Days after the participation closes within which an issued item is returned (closing date is day 0) | Replacement charge per unreturned issued item |
|---|---|---|---|
| Campus Club Membership | no | 10 | 0.00 |
| UIL Academic and Robotics Team | no | 10 | 0.00 |
| Middle School UIL Athletics | yes | 10 | 95.00 |
| Fine Arts Performing Ensemble | yes | 10 | 310.00 |
| High School UIL Athletics | yes | 10 | 145.00 |
| Cheer and Dance Team | no | 10 | 0.00 |
| Grade 5 Outdoor Education Trip | no | 10 | 0.00 |

The replacement charge is 0.00 where no equipment is issued. Days are calendar days.

## Points of reading (hypothetical dates)

- A Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation that closes on a hypothetical day 0 has its issued items due back by day 10; an item still unreturned after day 10 carries a charge of 310.00 for its tag.
- Two unreturned items on a High School UIL Athletics participation carry two charges of 145.00, one per tag.
